description.value: A modified n-back working-memory task with emotional-face distracters, used to elicit effortful emotion regulation. The task included 0-back and 2-back working-memory conditions and no-face, happy-face, fearful-face, and neutral-face distracter conditions; only the effortful 2-back condition was analyzed.

spans.text: 0-back

description.value: A low-load working-memory condition in which participants responded according to the target-letter rule while emotional face distracters were presented.

spans.text: 2-back

description.value: An effortful working-memory condition in which participants responded when the target letter matched the letter presented two trials previously, while inhibiting responses to emotional face distracters; only this condition was used for the primary emotion-regulation fMRI analyses.

spans.text: In addition to the working memory conditions (0-back and 2-back), four emotional valence distracter conditions (no faces, happy faces, fearful faces, and neutral faces) were presented to participants.

description.value: Blocks in which grayscale happy faces flanked the n-back letter stimuli and participants performed the assigned 0-back or 2-back working-memory task.

spans.text: Each block started with instructions indicating the working memory condition (0-back or 2-back) presented on the screen for 3500 ms, which was followed by the target stimulus (letters) presented flanked by the different emotional valence distracter conditions (happy, fearful, neutral, or no face) for 500 ms, with an interstimulus interval jittered at an average of 3500 ms.
